scope: Phase 1 development funnel and Phase 2 frozen-candidate proxy evaluation; labels are future authorship and do not establish real-world relevance.
dominant: historically known author source retrieval miss
decision: Branch A: test bounded acronym-aware query expansion as an additional retrieval route with author cap fixed at 800; do not train a ranker.
hypothesis: Expanding established CS acronyms may bring complementary candidate authors without future labels.
predeclared_gate: Pilot on inspected 129-query development set, same graph, candidates <=800. Do not promote without improved top-ten ranking and defensible latency; compare recall and oracle separately. If no clear signal stop before fresh evaluation.
additional_work: The one-paper-per-author cross-encoder pilot was run during audit as a bounded ranking diagnostic; uncertain +0.002 nDCG and added CPU cost, no promotion.
limitations: Counts overlap across queries and labels are incomplete.
This ranking identifies the largest proxy-instance loss, not proven lost human relevance.
